definitions.explanation: A person who assists a high-ranking official in government, military, or organizational contexts, typically in an advisory capacity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧{補佐官|ほさかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The Prime Minister's aide held a press conference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安全保障|あんぜんほしょう}→安全保障：05788_anzenhoshou⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補佐官|ほさかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was appointed as an adviser in charge of national security.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧{補佐官|ほさかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{助言|じょげん}→助言：05461_jogen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The presidential adviser is in a position to directly advise the president on foreign policy.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{補佐|ほさ}→補佐：19834_hosa⟧ (assistance/support) and {官|かん} (official/officer). This word frequently appears in news reports about government and politics, both domestic and international.

In the Japanese government, {内閣総理大臣補佐官|ないかくそうりだいじんほさかん} (Prime Minister's Special Adviser) is a formal position established by law. In translations of foreign politics, it is commonly used for positions like the U.S. National Security Advisor ({国家安全保障担当大統領補佐官|こっかあんぜんほしょうたんとうだいとうりょうほさかん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧{補佐官|ほさかん}: Prime Minister's adviser
- ⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧{補佐官|ほさかん}: presidential adviser
- ⟦{安全保障|あんぜんほしょう}→安全保障：05788_anzenhoshou⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧{補佐官|ほさかん}: national security adviser
- {補佐官|ほさかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appoint as an adviser

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{補佐|ほさ}→補佐：19834_hosa⟧: assistance; aide (without the official title nuance)
- ⟦{顧問|こもん}→顧問：16146_komon⟧: adviser; counselor (often for private organizations)
- ⟦{秘書官|ひしょかん}→秘書官：25520_hishokan⟧: secretary (to a high-ranking official)
